ios.desc:
Discover the tech world's pulse with FlipHN, a modern and interactive client for Hacker News.

Designed for speed and engagement, FlipHN lets you swipe through the top stories, creating a seamless reading experience. Whether you're a developer, entrepreneur, or tech enthusiast, staying updated has never been this fun.

Key Features:

Swipe Interface: Effortlessly browse stories with simple gestures. Swipe right to save, left to skip.
Smart Translation: Instantly translate titles and comments into your preferred language using native AI translation.
Offline Reading: Save articles and read them later, even without an internet connection.
Beautiful Themes: Optimized for day and night reading with system-integrated dark mode.

Pro Features:

Unlimited story saves (Free version limited to 20)
100% Ad-free experience
Full offline mode access
Join the community and flip your way through the latest in technology, startups, and programming.

Legal: By using FlipHN, you agree to our Terms of Use (EULA) and Privacy Policy:

Privacy Policy: https://firtina.co/fliphn
Terms of Use (EULA):  https://firtina.co/fliphn

show_hn.title: Show HN: FlipHN – A Tinder-like way to browse Hacker News

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built FlipHN, a Hacker News reader with a swipe-based interface:
– Swipe right to save stories
– Swipe left to skip
– Built-in translation for non-native English readers

The goal was to make HN browsing faster and more accessible on mobile.

Would love feedback, especially from heavy HN readers.
